edits.old: - No personal data in logs, events, workflow inputs or reports: every key is synthetic, the partner is read by code and the case by id, and the events carry IDs and facts only.
edits.new: - No customer value in logs, events, workflow inputs or reports: every key is synthetic, the partner is read by code and the case by id, and the events carry IDs and facts only. `decision_log_entry.inputs_ref` (DF-DEC-008) is personal data, category Customer data, classed Confidential (Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v5): it is shown only within the role's scope; in events and workflow inputs it carries a business fact only (a code, an amount or a date), never beside a direct identifier; in logs, and so in the run report, only a code or an id appears, never the customer value.
